overall_reason: The calendar card uses only untinted greys on a white ground: ink #222222 for the heading, #444444 for event titles and #888888 for times and meta, with no chromatic colour and one #e9e9e9 hairline card edge.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES and T-NEUTRALS pass with three untinted text levels and one ground; nothing in the palette is chosen beyond the greys, so it stops at 7.

strengths: Three text greys (#222222, #444444, #888888) each hold one role: heading, event title, time and meta.
One ground and one hairline edge: no shadow, no tint, no second surface.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
